# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Report security issues **privately** through GitHub Security Advisories
(this repository → Security → Report a vulnerability). Do not open a public
issue, pull request, or discussion for a vulnerability.

Please include:

- a description of the issue and its impact
- steps to reproduce, or a proof of concept if you have one
- affected versions / commit if known

We will acknowledge the report and work with you on a fix and disclosure
timeline.

## Threat model

The product threat model, encryption boundary, and honest limits live in
[docs/SECURITY.md](../docs/SECURITY.md). That document is the cryptographic
design; this file is how to report a vulnerability.
